div.head: VI Atr Lat 11
div.ab: [10.2 f. missing (Liebermann] Conubia inlicita cunctis generaliter interdicimus Christianis; sed legi diuine cum Dei timore ubique adstringantur.
div.note: Latin paraphrase of VI Atr (early 11th c.; K = Cotton Claudius A III f. 30, perhaps by Archbishop Wulfstan). Liebermann gives no German translation for it: for the meaning see the matching Old English chapter of VI Atr above, which it paraphrases (Liebermann prints in small type the words that correspond exactly to the Old English).
